Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n183\t\n184\t**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n185\t\n186\tAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n187\t\n188\t### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n189\t\n190\t`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n191\t\n192\t**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n193\t\n194\t### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n195\t\n196\t`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n197\t\n198\t**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n199\t\n200\t### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n201\t\n202\tPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n203\t\n204\t**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n205\t\n206\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n207\t\n208\tWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n209\t\n210\t- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n211\t- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n212\t\n213\t### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n214\t\n215\tApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n216\t- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n217\t- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n218\t- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n219\t- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n220\t\n221\t### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n222\t\n223\tBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n224\t\n225\t**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n226\t\n227\tVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n228\t\n229\t### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n230\t\n231\tWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n232\t\n233\t### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n234\t\n235\tWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n236\t\n237\t### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n238\t\n239\tWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n240\t\n241\t**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n242\t\n243\t### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n244\t\n245\t`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n246\t\n247\t**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n248\t\n249\t### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n250\t\n251\tThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n254\t\n255\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n256\t\n257\t- **WS URL**: choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n652\t\n653\t### Fix Applied\n654\t**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n655\t1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n656\t2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n657\t3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n658\t\n659\t### What Was NOT Changed\n660\t- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n661\t- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n662\t- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n663\t- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n664\t\n665\t### Testing\n666\t- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n667\t- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n668\t- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n669\t- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n670\t\n671\t### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\n672\tAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n673\t\n674\t1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n675\t2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n676\t3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n677\t\n678\t### Remaining Known Issues\n679\t- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n680\t- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n681\t- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n682\t- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n683\t\n684\t---\n685\t\n686\t## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n687\t\n688\t### Overview\n689\tRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n690\t\n691\t---\n692\t\n693\t### 1. Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n\n**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n\nAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n\n### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n\n`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n\n**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n\n### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n\n`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n\n**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n\n### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n\nPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n\n**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n\nWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n\n- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n\n### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n\nApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n\n### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n\nBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n\n**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n\nVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n\n### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n\nWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n\n**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n\n### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n\n`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n\n**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n\n### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n\nThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Browser was stuck waiting for the Deepgram TCP handshake.\n\n**Fix**: Return 101 to browser immediately, connect to Deepgram via `ctx.waitUntil()` in background. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n\n- **WS URL**: `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` (NOT just `/`)\n- **Auth**: `Authorization: Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}` header on the WS upgrade fetch\n- **Settings**: sent after receiving `Welcome` event from server\n- **User text injection**: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}` (NOT TextInput)\n- **Agent speech injection**: `{type: \"InjectAgentMessage\", content: \"...\"}`\n- **Managed LLMs (no key)**: `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` with NO `endpoint` — Deepgram pays for it\n- **Managed LLMs available**: OpenAI, Anthropic (`claude-4-5-haiku-latest`), Google `aura-2-asteria-en`\n- **Client sends audio**: binary PCM16 frames directly over WS\n- **Server events**: `Welcome`, `SettingsApplied`, `ConversationText` (role: user|assistant), `AgentAudioDone`, Mic button cycles on/off in reconnect loop. FIX — GAPLESS PLAYBACK v2 (2026-05-31)\n\n### Problem\nVoice agent audio was choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n\n### Fix Applied\n**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n\n### What Was NOT Changed\n- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n\n### Testing\n- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n\n### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\nAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n\n1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n\n### Remaining Known Issues\n- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n\n---\n\n## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n\n### Overview\nRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n\n---\n\n### 1. Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n183\t\n184\t**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n185\t\n186\tAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n187\t\n188\t### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n189\t\n190\t`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n191\t\n192\t**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n193\t\n194\t### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n195\t\n196\t`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n197\t\n198\t**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n199\t\n200\t### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n201\t\n202\tPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n203\t\n204\t**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n205\t\n206\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n207\t\n208\tWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n209\t\n210\t- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n211\t- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n212\t\n213\t### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n214\t\n215\tApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n216\t- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n217\t- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n218\t- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n219\t- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n220\t\n221\t### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n222\t\n223\tBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n224\t\n225\t**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n226\t\n227\tVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n228\t\n229\t### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n230\t\n231\tWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n232\t\n233\t### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n234\t\n235\tWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n236\t\n237\t### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n238\t\n239\tWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n240\t\n241\t**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n242\t\n243\t### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n244\t\n245\t`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n246\t\n247\t**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n248\t\n249\t### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n250\t\n251\tThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Browser was stuck waiting for the Deepgram TCP handshake.\n252\t\n253\t**Fix**: Return 101 to browser immediately, connect to Deepgram via `ctx.waitUntil()` in background. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n254\t\n255\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n256\t\n257\t- **WS URL**: `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` (NOT just `/`)\n258\t- **Auth**: `Authorization: Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}` header on the WS upgrade fetch\n259\t- **Settings**: sent after receiving choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n652\t\n653\t### Fix Applied\n654\t**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n655\t1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n656\t2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n657\t3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n658\t\n659\t### What Was NOT Changed\n660\t- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n661\t- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n662\t- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n663\t- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n664\t\n665\t### Testing\n666\t- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n667\t- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n668\t- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n669\t- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n670\t\n671\t### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\n672\tAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n673\t\n674\t1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n675\t2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n676\t3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n677\t\n678\t### Remaining Known Issues\n679\t- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n680\t- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n681\t- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n682\t- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n683\t\n684\t---\n685\t\n686\t## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n687\t\n688\t### Overview\n689\tRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n690\t\n691\t---\n692\t\n693\t### 1. Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n\n**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n\nAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n\n### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n\n`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n\n**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n\n### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n\n`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n\n**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n\n### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n\nPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n\n**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n\nWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n\n- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n\n### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n\nApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n\n### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n\nBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n\n**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n\nVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n\n### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n\nWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n\n**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n\n### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n\n`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n\n**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n\n### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n\nThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Browser was stuck waiting for the Deepgram TCP handshake.\n\n**Fix**: Return 101 to browser immediately, connect to Deepgram via `ctx.waitUntil()` in background. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n\n- **WS URL**: `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` (NOT just `/`)\n- **Auth**: `Authorization: Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}` header on the WS upgrade fetch\n- **Settings**: sent after receiving `Welcome` event from server\n- **User text injection**: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}` (NOT TextInput)\n- **Agent speech injection**: `{type: \"InjectAgentMessage\", content: \"...\"}`\n- **Managed LLMs (no key)**: `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` with NO `endpoint` — Deepgram pays for it\n- **Managed LLMs available**: OpenAI, Anthropic (`claude-4-5-haiku-latest`), Google `aura-2-asteria-en`\n- **Client sends audio**: binary PCM16 frames directly over WS\n- **Server events**: `Welcome`, `SettingsApplied`, `ConversationText` (role: user|assistant), `AgentAudioDone`, Mic button cycles on/off in reconnect loop. FIX — GAPLESS PLAYBACK v2 (2026-05-31)\n\n### Problem\nVoice agent audio was choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n\n### Fix Applied\n**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n\n### What Was NOT Changed\n- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n\n### Testing\n- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n\n### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\nAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n\n1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n\n### Remaining Known Issues\n- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n\n---\n\n## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n\n### Overview\nRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n\n---\n\n### 1. continue }\n    $newEntries = @()\n    Get-Content $filePath | ForEach-Object {\n        $obj = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n        if (-not $obj) { return }\n        if ($useReal) {\n            if ($obj.type -ne \"user\") { return }\n            foreach ($c in $obj.message.content) {\n                if ($c.type -eq \"text\" -and $c.text) {\n                    $newEntries += [ordered]@{ run=$run; source=$source; text=$text; char_count=$text.Length }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    $bible.entries += $newEntries\n    Write-Host \"Run $run ($source): +$($newEntries.Count) entries\"\n}\n$bible.total_entries = $bible.entries.Count\n$uniqueRuns = ($bible.entries | ForEach-Object { $_.run } | Sort-Object -Unique).Count\n$bible | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress | Set-Content $biblePath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"Bible updated: $($bible.total_entries) total entries, $uniqueRuns unique runs\"\n```\n\n- **`CANON/SOUL/BIBLE-OF-THE-SYSTEM.json`** — Updated: 1979 → 2056 entries, now covers runs 1-85. ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n248\t# EC-026: DUAL-HASH DETERMINISM NORMALIZATION\n249\t# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n250\t# DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED:\n251\t#   JSONL path STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n292\t\n293\t```powershell\n294\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n295\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n296\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n297\t return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n315\t}\n316\t\n317\tif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null Applied to all 3 portals.\n173\t\n174\t---\n175\t\n176\t## OBI Voice + Chat Fixes — 2026-05-29\n177\t\n178\t### Root Cause: Serial context fetches killed latency\n179\t\n180\t`handleChat()` in `index.js` had **7 sequential `await` calls** before the DeepSeek call:\n181\tLedger DO → Session DO → Weakness DO → Pet DO → `buildStructuredContext()` (4 more DOs) → Soul logger HTTP → KV reads.\n182\tEach could be 200-500ms. Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n183\t\n184\t**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n185\t\n186\tAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n187\t\n188\t### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n189\t\n190\t`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n191\t\n192\t**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n193\t\n194\t### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n195\t\n196\t`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n197\t\n198\t**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n199\t\n200\t### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n201\t\n202\tPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n203\t\n204\t**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n205\t\n206\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n207\t\n208\tWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n209\t\n210\t- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n211\t- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n212\t\n213\t### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n214\t\n215\tApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n216\t- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n217\t- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n218\t- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n219\t- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n220\t\n221\t### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n222\t\n223\tBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n224\t\n225\t**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n226\t\n227\tVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n228\t\n229\t### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n230\t\n231\tWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n232\t\n233\t### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n234\t\n235\tWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n236\t\n237\t### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n238\t\n239\tWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n240\t\n241\t**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n242\t\n243\t### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n244\t\n245\t`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n246\t\n247\t**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n248\t\n249\t### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n250\t\n251\tThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Browser was stuck waiting for the Deepgram TCP handshake.\n252\t\n253\t**Fix**: Return 101 to browser immediately, connect to Deepgram via `ctx.waitUntil()` in background. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n254\t\n255\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n256\t\n257\t- **WS URL**: `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` (NOT just `/`)\n258\t- **Auth**: `Authorization: Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}` header on the WS upgrade fetch\n259\t- **Settings**: sent after receiving `Welcome` event from server\n260\t- **User text injection**: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}` (NOT TextInput)\n261\t- **Agent speech injection**: `{type: \"InjectAgentMessage\", content: \"...\"}`\n262\t- **Managed LLMs (no key)**: `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` with NO `endpoint` — Deepgram pays for it\n263\t- **Managed LLMs available**: OpenAI, Anthropic (`claude-4-5-haiku-latest`), Google (`gemini-2.5-flash`), NVIDIA\n264\t- **BYO LLMs require key**: Groq, AWS Bedrock — need your own endpoint + credentials\n265\t- **STT model**: `nova-3` (or `flux-general-en` for newer)\n266\t- **TTS model**: `aura-2-asteria-en`\n267\t- **Client sends audio**: binary PCM16 frames directly over WS\n268\t- **Server events**: `Welcome`, choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n652\t\n653\t### Fix Applied\n654\t**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n655\t1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n656\t2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n657\t3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n658\t\n659\t### What Was NOT Changed\n660\t- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n661\t- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n662\t- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n663\t- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n664\t\n665\t### Testing\n666\t- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n667\t- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n668\t- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n669\t- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n670\t\n671\t### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\n672\tAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n673\t\n674\t1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n675\t2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n676\t3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n677\t\n678\t### Remaining Known Issues\n679\t- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n680\t- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n681\t- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n682\t- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n\n**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n\nAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n\n### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n\n`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n\n**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n\n### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n\n`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n\n**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n\n### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n\nPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n\n**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n\nWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n\n- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n\n### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n\nApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n\n### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n\nBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n\n**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n\nVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n\n### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n\nWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n\n**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n\n### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n\n`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n\n**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n\n### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n\nThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Browser was stuck waiting for the Deepgram TCP handshake.\n\n**Fix**: Return 101 to browser immediately, connect to Deepgram via `ctx.waitUntil()` in background. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n\n- **WS URL**: `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` (NOT just `/`)\n- **Auth**: `Authorization: Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}` header on the WS upgrade fetch\n- **Settings**: sent after receiving `Welcome` event from server\n- **User text injection**: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}` (NOT TextInput)\n- **Agent speech injection**: `{type: \"InjectAgentMessage\", content: \"...\"}`\n- **Managed LLMs (no key)**: `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` with NO `endpoint` — Deepgram pays for it\n- **Managed LLMs available**: OpenAI, Anthropic (`claude-4-5-haiku-latest`), Google (`gemini-2.5-flash`), NVIDIA\n- **BYO LLMs require key**: Groq, AWS Bedrock — need your own endpoint + credentials\n- **STT model**: `nova-3` (or `flux-general-en` for newer)\n- **TTS model**: `aura-2-asteria-en`\n- **Client sends audio**: binary PCM16 frames directly over WS\n- **Server events**: `Welcome`, `SettingsApplied`, `ConversationText` (role: user|assistant), `AgentAudioDone`, `UserStartedSpeaking`, binary MP3 chunks\n\n### Deploy History (2026-05-29)\n| Version ID | What changed |\n|---|---|\n| `8c34e784` | handleChat bilingual + teachingFocus fix |\n| `d2212f87` | FIX — GAPLESS PLAYBACK v2 (2026-05-31)\n\n### Problem\nVoice agent audio was choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n\n### Fix Applied\n**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n\n### What Was NOT Changed\n- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n\n### Testing\n- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n\n### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\nAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n\n1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n\n### Remaining Known Issues\n- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n\n---\n\n## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n\n### Overview\nRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n\n---\n\n### 1. ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n248\t# EC-026: DUAL-HASH DETERMINISM NORMALIZATION\n249\t# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n250\t# DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED:\n251\t#   JSONL path STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n292\t\n293\t```powershell\n294\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n295\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n296\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n297\t ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n248\t# EC-026: DUAL-HASH DETERMINISM NORMALIZATION\n249\t# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n250\t# DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED:\n251\t#   JSONL path STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n292\t\n293\t```powershell\n294\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n295\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n296\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n297\t Not AI summaries — human-written specs.\n\n### 1. `endpointing` was NEVER a Voice Agent API field — it was cargo-culted from the wrong spec\n\n`listen.endpointing` is a valid field in Deepgram's **streaming transcription** API (`wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen`). It controls silence duration before an utterance is considered ended.\n\nIt does **not exist** in the **Voice Agent** API (`wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`). The full `listen.provider` spec for Voice Agent is:\n\n```json\n\"listen\": {\n  \"provider\": {\n    \"type\": \"deepgram\",\n    \"model\": \"nova-3\",\n    \"smart_format\": false,\n    \"language\": \"en\",\n    \"keyterms\": [],\n    \"eot_threshold\": 0.7,\n    \"eager_eot_threshold\": 0.5\n  }\n}\n```\n\nNo `endpointing`. The end-of-turn equivalent in Voice Agent is **`eot_threshold`** — a confidence float (0.5–0.9, default 0.7), not a millisecond integer. `eager_eot_threshold` allows early cutoff before the user fully stops. **Both are Flux-model only** — nova-3 uses internal defaults and ignores them.\n\nSource: [Deepgram configure-voice-agent docs](https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/configure-voice-agent) — human-written field list.\n\n### 2. Deepgram ran a V1 migration that changed the entire settings schema — we never read it\n\nThe [Voice Agent V1 migration guide](https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/voice-agent-v1-migration) documents breaking changes including:\n- `session_id` → `request_id` in Welcome\n- `message` → `description` in errors\n- `message` → `content` in InjectAgentMessage\n- Full settings schema restructure\n\nWe were on V1 already but had cargo-culted fields from pre-V1 examples. The migration guide is the authoritative human source for what is and isn't valid. **It must be read before any settings change.**\n\n### 3. The correct message order (from Deepgram staff, GitHub discussion #1478)\n\nDeepgram staff (John Vajda) confirmed: `CLIENT_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT` and disconnects happen when audio is sent before `SettingsApplied`. The mandatory sequence is:\n\n```\nWS connect → Welcome → send Settings → SettingsApplied → then audio / InjectAgentMessage\n```\n\nOur `chat.js` buffers pre-SettingsApplied PCM and flushes after (EC-15 fix) — this is correct. **But if Settings is rejected (Error instead of SettingsApplied), the whole sequence stalls and the student hears nothing.** GATE 3 is the only thing that catches this.\n\n### 4. What the pre-deploy process must include going forward\n\nBefore changing ANY field in the voice settings block (`agent.listen`, `agent.think`, `agent.speak`, `audio`):\n\n1. **Check the field against the Voice Agent spec** — not the STT spec, not the SDK README, not a ChatGPT summary. The source of truth is [developers.deepgram.com/docs/configure-voice-agent](https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/configure-voice-agent).\n2. **Check the V1 migration guide** for whether the field was renamed or removed.\n3. **Run GATE 3** (`node test/preflight-ws.mjs`) against dev before deploying. SettingsApplied = field accepted. Error = field rejected, field name is in `description`. This is a 10-second check that would have caught the endpointing bug instantly.\n\nThe process failure was not a code bug — it was never reading the right human spec. A static source check would not have caught this. Only a live round-trip catches it.\n\n---\n\n## TOOLCHAIN INSTALL (one-time — all open source, all npm)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":410,"cache_read_input_tokens":128364,"output_tokens":1301,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":410,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":1301,"cache_read_input_tokens":128364,"cache_creation_input_tokens":410,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":410},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CbqeDA2YJG6QPUtxCqt7C","type":"assistant","uuid":"5892e394-1c66-4f62-9b17-8f95a9b381fe","timestamp":"2026-06-08T10:34:29.654Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"D:\\OB-1-CANONICAL","sessionId":"546cc484-6f27-4b01-930e-6c52fe2a30ef","version":"2.1.167","gitBranch":"master","slug":"harmonic-wibbling-crystal"}

Runtime visibility, synthetic monitoring, structured logging, alerting, graceful degradation, KV performance. Zero overlap with `/netpet-preflight` (which covers pre-deploy gates).\n\n**The gap this closes:** Today we find out OBI is broken when Michael rages. There is no proactive signal. No student session telemetry. No structured error trail. No canary. No auto-recovery. Flying completely blind in production between manual test runs.\n\n**Doctrine:** \"If a student has a bad session and nobody logged it, it didn't happen until Michael found out the hard way.\"\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 1 — SYNTHETIC CANARY (the most important layer — catches the endpointing class without a deploy)\n\n**The failure it prevents:** The endpointing bug was not caused by our code changing. Deepgram changed their API under us. No pre-deploy gate catches that because we weren't deploying. A canary running every 5 minutes against live Deepgram would have fired the day they changed the spec.\n\n**What it does:** Reuses the existing `keep-warm-ping` scheduled Worker or a separate cron trigger. Every 5 minutes:\n1. Hits `/api/deepgram-token?studentId=sov100-test-magic` — asserts 200 + token\n2. Opens `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` with that token\n3. Sends the full Settings object\n4. Asserts `SettingsApplied` within 8s — **not** an Error\n5. Asserts at least one binary audio chunk within 5s after SettingsApplied\n6. Closes cleanly\n\n**Red state:** writes `canary:state = \"RED\"` + `canary:last_error = { ts, stage, description }` to KV, triggers alert (Layer 4). Green state: writes `canary:state = \"GREEN\"` + `canary:last_check = ts`.\n\n**Why 5 minutes:** Deepgram's own status page shows incidents resolving in 15-30 min windows. 5-min canary catches it within one check. Students typically tap the mic within 2-3 minutes of opening the portal — a 5-min canary means at most one student hits a broken session before the alert fires.\n\n**Cost:** CF Workers cron trigger — free tier covers unlimited triggers. The WS connection is 1 Deepgram credit per canary run. Acceptable.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 2 — POST-DEPLOY VERIFY + AUTO-ROLLBACK\n\n**The failure it prevents:** Currently we deploy and assume prod is healthy. A bad deploy can sit broken for an entire student session before anyone notices.\n\n**What it does:** Immediately after every `wrangler deploy`, a script:\n1. Waits 10s for CF propagation\n2. Runs `preflight-ws.mjs` against the just-deployed prod URL (same Gates 2-4)\n3. If all green → deployment confirmed, log deploy version to KV as `deploy:last_good`\n4. If red → **immediately runs `wrangler rollback`** → alerts operator → halts\n\n**Hard rule written into deploy procedure:** A `wrangler deploy` without the post-verify step is a protocol violation. The rollback window is ~60s. A broken deploy self-heals before the first student session after the deploy.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 3 — STRUCTURED LOGGING (replace console.error with durable signal)\n\n**The failure it prevents:** Every `catch` in the voice path today logs to `console.error`. That evaporates. No trail. No diff between \"one student had a blip\" and \"every student is broken.\"\n\n**Architecture:** A single `logVoiceEvent(env, event)` helper in `src/index.js`:\n\n```\nevent shape: {\n  ts:        epoch ms\n  version:   deploy version (git sha or uuid injected at deploy time)\n  studentId: anonymised (hash, not raw ID)\n  stage:     \"token_fetch\" | \"ws_auth\" | \"settings\" | \"audio\" | \"session_end\"\n  ok:        boolean\n  error:     string | null\n  latency_ms: number\n}\n```\n\n**Sink options (pick one, in order of complexity):**\n- `NET_PET_KV.put(\"log:voice:\" + ts, JSON.stringify(event), { expirationTtl: 604800 })` — 7-day ring buffer in KV. Zero infra. Queryable via `/api/admin/logs`. Sufficient for current scale (3 active students).\n- Logpush to R2 — better for high volume, overkill now.\n- Worker Analytics Engine — Cloudflare native, free, queryable via GraphQL. Best long-term option.\n\n**What gets logged:**\n- Every `/api/deepgram-token` call: studentId hash, latency, ok/error\n- Every circuit breaker state change: open → closed, closed → open, why\n- Every canary run result: stage reached, latency, error description\n- Every post-deploy verify result\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 4 — ALERTING (one real channel, fires on canary red + post-deploy red)\n\n**What it does NOT do:** Email (slow, spam-filtered). Slack webhook (extra setup). Dashboard (no one watches dashboards).\n\n**What it does:** Telegram bot message to operator. Single POST to `https://api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}/sendMessage`. Arrives on Michael's phone in under 2 seconds. Message format:\n\n```\n🔴 OBI CANARY RED — [stage] failed\nError: [Deepgram description]\nStudents affected: YES (canary fires before next session)\nDeploy version: [version]\nTime: [ts]\nCheck: status.deepgram.com + wrangler tail\n```\n\n**Triggers:**\n- Canary red (any stage)\n- Post-deploy verify red → includes rollback confirmation\n- Circuit breaker opened under student load (not canary)\n- KV error rate > 0 under student load\n\n**Setup required:** One Telegram bot (BotFather, 2 min), one env secret `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` + `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`. Already using CF secrets infra — no new system.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 5 — GRACEFUL DEGRADATION (students get something, not silence)\n\n**The failure it prevents:** When Deepgram is down or canary is RED, a student taps the mic and hears nothing. No message. No explanation. Just silence and confusion.\n\n**What OBI does today when voice breaks:** `onAgentDrop` fires → mic button hidden → network fallback banner shown → text input appears. This is correct for transient network issues but gives no explanation.\n\n**What it should do when the canary is RED:**\n- `/api/deepgram-token` checks `canary:state` in KV before doing anything\n- If RED: returns `{ error: \"voice_unavailable\", message: \"OBI's voice is having a moment — try text chat for now\", retryAfter: 300 }`\n- Portal shows a human-friendly banner: *\"OBI is resting — tap to chat by text instead\"*\n- Text input mode activates automatically (already built in `chat.js`)\n- Student is not left staring at a broken mic with zero feedback\n\n**Cost of this:** 1 KV read (< 1ms) added to the token handler. Returns 503 with a message instead of silent failure. Canary already writes `canary:state` — this just reads it.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 6 — KV PERFORMANCE FIX (F1 finding — real measured problem)\n\n**The evidence:** Load test from Run 101: 10 concurrent requests, 5s burst → avg **1010ms** latency, **p99 1469ms**, **1 of 44 requests returned 500**. Root cause: every `/api/deepgram-token` call does 8 parallel KV reads + builds the full agent prompt synchronously, every time, for every token request.\n\n**What makes this a real student problem:** Vietnamese students are on mobile networks. 1s token fetch + 200ms WS open + 400ms SettingsApplied = 1.6s before OBI says the first word. On a slow 4G connection this is 3-4s. Students hear silence and tap again. Double connection, chaos.\n\n**Fix architecture:**\n\n```\nFAST PATH: student has cached profile (most sessions)\n  - KV get: student_profile + lang + vocab (3 reads, 50ms)\n  - Skip: session_history, srs_data, memory, phonics (these are for prompt enrichment only)\n  - Return token + base settings in < 200ms\n\nENRICHED PATH: fire-and-forget after token returned\n  - Fetch session_history + srs_data + memory async\n  - Write enriched prompt to KV as \"prompt_cache:{studentId}:{mode}\" with 5min TTL\n  - Next fast-path call reads prompt from cache instead of rebuilding\n\nRESULT: first session of the day = 200ms (fast path)\n         subsequent sessions = < 100ms (cache hit)\n         prompt freshness = 5min max staleness (acceptable — session history doesn't change mid-session)\n```\n\n**What this does NOT touch:** voice brain lock, settings structure, Deepgram WS flow. Pure KV read optimization.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 7 — /api/health/voice ENDPOINT (one-curl diagnosis)\n\n**The failure it prevents:** Currently diagnosing a broken OBI means reading KV manually, checking CF logs, running preflight-ws.mjs. Takes 5+ minutes.\n\n**What it does:** A single authenticated GET returns the complete voice health picture in one JSON response:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ok\": true,\n  \"canary\": {\n    \"state\": \"GREEN\",\n    \"last_check\": \"2026-06-08T09:00:00Z\",\n    \"last_error\": null\n  },\n  \"circuit_breaker\": {\n    \"state\": \"closed\"\n  },\n  \"deploy\": {\n    \"version\": \"b2341008\",\n    \"last_good_deploy\": \"2026-06-08T08:55:00Z\"\n  },\n  \"kv_latency_ms\": 45,\n  \"deepgram_key_alive\": true\n}\n```\n\n**Auth:** requires `X-Admin-Key` header matching a CF secret. Not public.\n\n**How it's used:** First thing to run when Michael suspects something is wrong. Replaces the 5-minute archaeology dig.\n\n---\n\n## BUILD ORDER (when you say go — each item is one session)\n\n| # | Layer | Effort | Impact |\n|---|-------|--------|--------|\n| 1 | Canary (Layer 1) | 1 session | Catches Deepgram spec drift automatically. Runtime visibility, synthetic monitoring, structured logging, alerting, graceful degradation, KV performance. Zero overlap with `/netpet-preflight` (which covers pre-deploy gates).\n\n**The gap this closes:** Today we find out OBI is broken when Michael rages. There is no proactive signal. No student session telemetry. No structured error trail. No canary. No auto-recovery. Flying completely blind in production between manual test runs.\n\n**Doctrine:** \"If a student has a bad session and nobody logged it, it didn't happen until Michael found out the hard way.\"\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 1 — SYNTHETIC CANARY (the most important layer — catches the endpointing class without a deploy)\n\n**The failure it prevents:** The endpointing bug was not caused by our code changing. Deepgram changed their API under us. No pre-deploy gate catches that because we weren't deploying. A canary running every 5 minutes against live Deepgram would have fired the day they changed the spec.\n\n**What it does:** Reuses the existing `keep-warm-ping` scheduled Worker or a separate cron trigger. Every 5 minutes:\n1. Hits `/api/deepgram-token?studentId=sov100-test-magic` — asserts 200 + token\n2. Opens `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` with that token\n3. Sends the full Settings object\n4. Asserts `SettingsApplied` within 8s — **not** an Error\n5. Asserts at least one binary audio chunk within 5s after SettingsApplied\n6. Closes cleanly\n\n**Red state:** writes `canary:state = \"RED\"` + `canary:last_error = { ts, stage, description }` to KV, triggers alert (Layer 4). Green state: writes `canary:state = \"GREEN\"` + `canary:last_check = ts`.\n\n**Why 5 minutes:** Deepgram's own status page shows incidents resolving in 15-30 min windows. 5-min canary catches it within one check. Students typically tap the mic within 2-3 minutes of opening the portal — a 5-min canary means at most one student hits a broken session before the alert fires.\n\n**Cost:** CF Workers cron trigger — free tier covers unlimited triggers. The WS connection is 1 Deepgram credit per canary run. Acceptable.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 2 — POST-DEPLOY VERIFY + AUTO-ROLLBACK\n\n**The failure it prevents:** Currently we deploy and assume prod is healthy. A bad deploy can sit broken for an entire student session before anyone notices.\n\n**What it does:** Immediately after every `wrangler deploy`, a script:\n1. Waits 10s for CF propagation\n2. Runs `preflight-ws.mjs` against the just-deployed prod URL (same Gates 2-4)\n3. If all green → deployment confirmed, log deploy version to KV as `deploy:last_good`\n4. If red → **immediately runs `wrangler rollback`** → alerts operator → halts\n\n**Hard rule written into deploy procedure:** A `wrangler deploy` without the post-verify step is a protocol violation. The rollback window is ~60s. A broken deploy self-heals before the first student session after the deploy.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 3 — STRUCTURED LOGGING (replace console.error with durable signal)\n\n**The failure it prevents:** Every `catch` in the voice path today logs to `console.error`. That evaporates. No trail. No diff between \"one student had a blip\" and \"every student is broken.\"\n\n**Architecture:** A single `logVoiceEvent(env, event)` helper in `src/index.js`:\n\n```\nevent shape: {\n  ts:        epoch ms\n  version:   deploy version (git sha or uuid injected at deploy time)\n  studentId: anonymised (hash, not raw ID)\n  stage:     \"token_fetch\" | \"ws_auth\" | \"settings\" | \"audio\" | \"session_end\"\n  ok:        boolean\n  error:     string | null\n  latency_ms: number\n}\n```\n\n**Sink options (pick one, in order of complexity):**\n- `NET_PET_KV.put(\"log:voice:\" + ts, JSON.stringify(event), { expirationTtl: 604800 })` — 7-day ring buffer in KV. Zero infra. Queryable via `/api/admin/logs`. Sufficient for current scale (3 active students).\n- Logpush to R2 — better for high volume, overkill now.\n- Worker Analytics Engine — Cloudflare native, free, queryable via GraphQL. Best long-term option.\n\n**What gets logged:**\n- Every `/api/deepgram-token` call: studentId hash, latency, ok/error\n- Every circuit breaker state change: open → closed, closed → open, why\n- Every canary run result: stage reached, latency, error description\n- Every post-deploy verify result\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 4 — ALERTING (one real channel, fires on canary red + post-deploy red)\n\n**What it does NOT do:** Email (slow, spam-filtered). Slack webhook (extra setup). Dashboard (no one watches dashboards).\n\n**What it does:** Telegram bot message to operator. Single POST to `https://api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}/sendMessage`. Arrives on Michael's phone in under 2 seconds. Already using CF secrets infra — no new system.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 5 — GRACEFUL DEGRADATION (students get something, not silence)\n\n**The failure it prevents:** When Deepgram is down or canary is RED, a student taps the mic and hears nothing. No message. No explanation. Just silence and confusion.\n\n**What OBI does today when voice breaks:** `onAgentDrop` fires → mic button hidden → network fallback banner shown → text input appears. This is correct for transient network issues but gives no explanation.\n\n**What it should do when the canary is RED:**\n- `/api/deepgram-token` checks `canary:state` in KV before doing anything\n- If RED: returns `{ error: \"voice_unavailable\", message: \"OBI's voice is having a moment — try text chat for now\", retryAfter: 300 }`\n- Portal shows a human-friendly banner: *\"OBI is resting — tap to chat by text instead\"*\n- Text input mode activates automatically (already built in `chat.js`)\n- Student is not left staring at a broken mic with zero feedback\n\n**Cost of this:** 1 KV read (< 1ms) added to the token handler. Returns 503 with a message instead of silent failure. Canary already writes `canary:state` — this just reads it.\n\n---\n\n## LAYER 6 — KV PERFORMANCE FIX (F1 finding — real measured problem)\n\n**The evidence:** Load test from Run 101: 10 concurrent requests, 5s burst → avg **1010ms** latency, **p99 1469ms**, **1 of 44 requests returned 500**. Root cause: every `/api/deepgram-token` call does 8 parallel KV reads + builds the full agent prompt synchronously, every time, for every token request.\n\n**What makes this a real student problem:** Vietnamese students are on mobile networks. 1s token fetch + 200ms WS open + 400ms SettingsApplied = 1.6s before OBI says the first word. On a slow 4G connection this is 3-4s. Students hear silence and tap again. Double connection, chaos.\n\n**Fix architecture:**\n\n```\nFAST PATH: student has cached profile (most sessions)\n  - KV get: student_profile + lang + vocab (3 reads, 50ms)\n  - Skip: session_history, srs_data, memory, phonics (these are for prompt enrichment only)\n  - Return token + base settings in < 200ms\n\nENRICHED PATH: fire-and-forget after token returned\n  - Fetch session_history + srs_data + memory async\n  - Write enriched prompt to KV as \"prompt_cache:{studentId}:{mode}\" with 5min TTL\n  - Next fast-path call reads prompt from cache instead of rebuilding\n\nRESULT: first session of the day = 200ms (fast path)\n         subsequent sessions = < 100ms (cache hit)\n         prompt freshness = 5min max staleness (acceptable — session history doesn't change mid-session)\n```\n\n**What this does NOT touch:** voice brain lock, settings structure, Deepgram WS flow.
